params.name: companyId
params.description: Enter the company ID of the employees you are searching for. This is not a mandatory parameter; hence, if you do not know the company ID, the response message contains details of all employees to which you have access. If you are searching for employees at the organisation level, ensure that the access token used for authentication has the correct permissions.

params.name: email
params.description: The email of the Employee you are searching for.

params.name: code
params.description: The external ID of the Employee you are searching for.

params.name: before
params.description: Lower bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [after] or [offset]).

params.name: after
params.description: Upper bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [offset]).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [after]).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum amount of items to return.

params.name: sorting_keys
params.description: The keys to sort the results by.

params.name: sorting_order
params.description: The order to sort the results by. Must be the same length as [sortingKeys]; one order per key.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to search for multiple employees.
Search for a specific employee by employee ID.
